email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Campaign Manager role at Gaming1. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web analytics, I am drawn to the opportunity to plan and execute campaigns for a leading gaming brand.

In my current role at Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, using data from Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to inform strategy and report on performance. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I built and optimized websites, ran SEO analyses, and measured campaign effectiveness. My experience with project management, attention to detail, and a proactive mindset aligns well with the responsibilities of this position.

I am fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Dutch. I thrive in fast-changing environments and am eager to contribute to Gaming1's international growth.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Campaign Manager position at Gaming1. With a solid foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web analytics, I am eager to bring my skills to your Brand Management Team and contribute to the success of your international campaigns.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation for client websites, tracking results with tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console. This experience has honed my ability to plan and execute marketing initiatives, measure their ROI, and use data to refine future campaigns. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I supported the development of digital workplace sites for major clients and built WordPress websites from the ground up, ensuring accuracy and attention to detail in all marketing materials.

What draws me to Gaming1 is the dynamic, international environment and the opportunity to work on ambitious projects. I thrive in fast-changing settings and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals. My technical background in front-end development and automation allows me to approach campaign management with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

I am fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Dutch, which I am continuously improving. I am confident that my blend of marketing and technical skills, along with my passion for gaming and digital innovation, makes me a strong fit for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Gaming1's continued growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Digital marketing experience with SEO, content, and web analytics, using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to track and report on campaign performance.
- Proven ability to plan and execute marketing initiatives, as shown in current role at Episto, managing SEO and content for client websites.
- Project management skills from building and optimizing websites at Knowledge Experts, including WordPress development and SEO analyses.
- Technical proficiency in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and automation with Python, enabling a proactive and data-driven approach to campaign management.
- Fluent in English and improving Dutch, with a strong attention to detail and a can-do attitude in fast-changing environments.
